{{Top|leg}}
'''Galdewik spiders''' were tiny, dangerous [[Spider/Legends|arachnids]]. [[Kumac]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] used hundreds of Galdewik spiders to breach the [[Armor/Legends|armor]] of a [[Monorail/Legends|monorail]] train car to kill the members of the [[Tamazall Militia]] inside while freeing [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Brahle Logris]].
